description:
Become a key part of a startup team that continues to grow and work on multiple products in multiple industries. Ideally looking for a full stack JavaScript developer with experience in Angular and Node.   
 We value the desire and ability to quickly learn new technologies and frameworks over years of experience. Work downtown out of Industrious in the heart of the startup culture in St Louis.  
 
 Fill a key role within our team working on our primary product suite. Ideally this will transition into a leadership role as the company expands. 
 Software development, namely development of server side applications and REST APIs using NodeJS, and client side web applications using Angular 4+. Will also include at times CMS (PHP), native Android (Java) and native iOS (Swift) development. We will mentor and train on these technologies as needed. Exploration and learning of new technologies beyond these will be encouraged and supported as well. 
 

 0-2 Years of Experience 
 Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field. 2016 and 2017 graduates encouraged to apply. Candidates with equivalent professional experience encouraged as well. 
 JavaScript (Required) 
 NodeJS and Angular 4+ (Preferred) 
 Experience with PHP based CMS (Nice to have) 
 Native Android and iOS (Nice to have) 

 
 Competitive base pay and world class benefits 
 Our goal is for you to not even think about pay or benefits, and only worry about building great products.   We take this off the table by offering better benefits than anyone else, and your work is all that’s left.   
 100% covered employee medical insurance 
 50% covered medical insurance for spouse, children or family 
 100% covered dental and vision insurance 
 401k with 4% match, immediate enrollment with no vesting period 
 10 days of PTO + 8 paid holidays 
   $50,000 life insurance policy with option for supplementary coverage 
 Voluntary short term disability & long term disability 
 HSA for qualified plans with employer contributions of Employee - $625, +Children - $925, +Spouse - $1000, +Family - $1250 
 FSA offered 
 Quality of Work 

 Quality to us means more than just day to day work. We encourage each team member to learn and think deeply about what it takes to make successful products.      
 Be a part of a startup in a fast-growing startup market. 
 Work on the latest technologies and with a team that encourages new ideas. 
 Build new products that set out to disrupt the marketplace. 
 Learn from an experienced team that places a high value on mentorship. 
 Be a part of a highly collaborative environment. 
 Work in the heart of the startup culture in St Louis at Industrious.
